title: Museum of Design Atlanta (MODA)

services.name: Host A Private Event
services.desc: By booking your event with MODA, you are supporting our mission to advance the understanding and appreciation of design as for visitors of all ages. Because MODA is the only exclusive design museum in the southeastern United States, it won’t surprise you to learn that we have a beautiful space in which you can design your own event. Our doors open up to three galleries that house exhibitions focused on the power of design and its ability to inspire change, transform lives, and make the world a better place.
